arguments.sql: WITH candidates AS (SELECT table_name FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_type='BASE TABLE' AND (table_name ~* '(project|product|release|artifact|capabil|component|program|system|schema_|migration|registry|audit)')) SELECT current_database() AS database_name, (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_type='BASE TABLE') AS public_table_count, (SELECT jsonb_agg(table_name ORDER BY table_name) FROM candidates) AS candidate_tables, (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',table_name,'column',column_name,'type',data_type,'udt',udt_name,'nullable',is_nullable,'default',column_default) ORDER BY table_name,ordinal_position) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name IN (SELECT table_name FROM candidates)) AS candidate_columns;
